title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：soup　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 soup 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the baker ① made the soup that no customer in the bakery would have recorded, and he said the making was the whole of the week. The ② soup, meaning the broth itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed unrecorded in the book; soup, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ piece of soup in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ soup at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Soup, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the baker said the recording is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the soup was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the broth. The ⑥ soup, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; soup, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both broth and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1964 the ⑦ soup had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ soup of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of recording; soup, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ soup I remember is the soup recorded in the bill, which closed in 1966 and is still recorded as the quietest in the bakery. ⑩ Soup, my mother said in 1968, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all soup, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like broth. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 汤（指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 汤（指那碗汤本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the soup 熬这一碗汤
D. n. 汤（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 汤之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的汤之事）
F. n. 汤（指账单里写到、被记载的那一碗）
G. n. 汤、暖意（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 暖意（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the soup that no customer in the bakery would have recorded
The soup, meaning the broth itself and not the tray
Every piece of soup in that bakery
the soup at the far oven

The soup of the whole thing

answers.why: make the soup 意为“熬这一碗汤”，1959 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯记载的一碗汤做了一遍。
soup 意为“汤”，指那碗汤本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记载。
soup 意为“汤”，指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
soup 意为“汤”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
soup 意为“汤、暖意”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这碗暖意就是那件事的全部。
soup 意为“暖意”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那碗汤，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
soup 意为“汤”，指账单里写到、被记载的那一碗，到 1964 年这一碗成了账单里的一行。
soup 意为“汤之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的汤之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的记载。
soup 意为“汤”，我记得的是账单里记载过的那一碗，1966 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一碗。
soup 为抽象总称，母亲 1968 年说，汤是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的汤。
